Name: AliveNpcs
Author: LUCASGATICA
Description:
[center][size=6][b]🌿 AliveNpcs[/b][/size][/center]
[center]
[size=4][b]AI-powered dialogue, memory, gossip, scenes, festivals, relationships, and emergent stories for Stardew Valley[/b][/size]

Make Pelican Town feel alive. Villagers remember you, react to your save, talk to each other, invite you into small scenes, write letters, spread rumors, and build stories that keep changing from day to day.

[color=#f0c040][b]AliveNpcs requires an AI provider.[/b][/color]
Use a Google Gemini API key, or configure an OpenAI-compatible/local LLM endpoint in the mod settings.

[url=https://aistudio.google.com/apikey][b]Get a Gemini API key here[/b][/url]
[b]Gemini users can add up to 20 API keys, and AliveNpcs can rotate between them when limits are reached.[/b]

[b]Discord:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/8vUfXEH852]https://discord.gg/8vUfXEH852[/url]
[/center]

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🌐 Supported Languages[/b][/size]
English · Português Brasileiro · Español · Français · Deutsch · Italiano

[i]The mod UI and player-facing text are localized in these languages. AI conversations are generated in the active language when the configured model follows the prompt correctly.[/i]
[/center]

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]What Is AliveNpcs?[/b][/size][/center]

AliveNpcs is a large AI-driven immersion mod for Stardew Valley. Instead of only showing fixed vanilla lines, NPCs can generate contextual dialogue when you talk to them. They can remember old conversations, react to gifts, gossip about public events, develop opinions about each other, send letters, participate in small scene events, respond to festivals, and carry long-running story arcs across your save.

The goal is not to turn Stardew into random chaos. The goal is a village that feels more reactive while still using each NPC's canon personality as the foundation.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]✨ Latest Highlights - 1.4.0[/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][b]Festival AI dialogue:[/b] supported festivals can use AliveNpcs prompts instead of only fixed festival lines. Current packs include the Egg Festival and Flower Dance support.[/*]
[*][b]Flower Dance partner action:[/b] during the Flower Dance, eligible NPCs can show an [b]Ask to dance[/b] action, evaluated with that NPC's memories, relationship, boundaries, and festival context.[/*]
[*][b]Bonus Actions menu:[/b] relationship proposals, hang-out invitations, festival actions, and Experimental Content buttons now live in a contextual action menu instead of cluttering the response box.[/*]
[*][b]Hang Out / Sair juntos:[/b] invite eligible NPCs to spend time with you. The NPC may accept or refuse based on personality, relationship, recent events, and your exact invitation.[/*]
[*][b]66 hang-out scene templates:[/b] accepted invitations can create short scene events in real locations, with AI-generated lines matched to the invitation.[/*]
[*][b]Outings tab:[/b] the AliveNpcs Hub now includes a place to review pending hang-out scenes and supported destinations.[/*]
[*][b]Dialogue Item Requests:[/b] NPCs can ask for small item favors through conversation. These become real Stardew Valley quests in the normal quest log.[/*]

[*][b]Experimental Content platform:[/b] external EC packs can add modes, prompts, dialogue actions, gossip hooks, scenes, runtime hooks, and mode-scoped narrative contributions.[/*]

[/list]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🧠 Core Features[/b][/size][/center]

[b]AI Dialogue That Uses Your Save[/b]
[list]
[*]Dialogue is generated on demand when you talk to an NPC.[/*]
[*]Type free-text responses instead of only choosing from fixed options.[/*]
[*]NPCs can consider time, season, weather, location, birthday context, gifts, heart level, seen heart events, Community Center progress, mine progress, marriage state, local gossip, story arcs, and recent memories.[/*]
[*]Multi-turn conversations are supported and configurable.[/*]
[*]Old conversation history is compacted so NPCs can keep continuity without bloating every prompt.[/*]
[*]Vanilla dialogue fallback can be enabled for safer behavior if the AI provider is unavailable.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Character Sheet and Roleplay Context[/b]
[list]
[*]Press [font=Courier New]F7[/font] to open the Character Sheet.[/*]
[*]Tell the mod who your farmer is, why they came to the valley, how they look, and what kind of story you are roleplaying.[/*]
[*]NPCs can use this context naturally in future dialogue.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Memory, Emotions, and Relationship Continuity[/b]
[list]
[*]NPCs remember important conversations and can bring them up later.[/*]
[*]Emotional profiles track trust, warmth, tension, closeness, boundaries, and memorable moments.[/*]
[*]Negative memories can matter without permanently ruining a save.[/*]
[*]Friendship points are still respected, but emotional tone and recent behavior also influence responses.[/*]
[*]NPC portraits can change with detected emotion.[/*]
[*]Gifts are remembered and can shape future dialogue.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Dynamic Personalities[/b]
[list]
[*]NPCs keep their canon personality as the base.[/*]
[*]Inside each save, they can slowly soften, become more guarded, trust you more, resent something, gain confidence, or remember a turning point.[/*]
[*]The prompt system is tuned to reduce repetitive caricatures, so NPCs should not constantly repeat the same hobby or one-note trait.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Social Drama and Village Opinions[/b]
[list]
[*]Gossip and events can change how NPCs feel about each other.[/*]
[*]NPCs can defend, doubt, resent, admire, or become protective of other villagers based on what they know.[/*]
[*]The farmer can influence opinions through dialogue by praising, warning, defending, or speaking badly about someone.[/*]
[*]Drama intensity is configurable: [b]Cozy[/b], [b]Balanced[/b], or [b]Telenovela[/b].[/*]
[*]Adult relationship drama, NPC-to-NPC romance, orientation discovery, and infidelity arcs are opt-in systems.[/*]
[*]Children and child-coded NPCs are protected from adult/romantic systems.[/*]
[*]Canon marriages are protected by default.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Gossip, Diary, and Weekly News[/b]
[list]
[*]Public interactions can become gossip instead of instantly becoming universal knowledge.[/*]
[*]Sociable NPCs are more likely to spread stories; isolated NPCs do not magically know everything.[/*]
[*]Use [b]Keep secret[/b] when you want a conversation to stay private.[/*]
[*]The personal diary records the story of your playthrough.[/*]
[*]The weekly village news summarizes what has been happening in the save.[/*]
[*]Festival memories can feed diary/gossip after supported festivals.[/*]
[/list]
[b]NPC-to-NPC Social Web[/b]
[list]
[*]Villagers can have small daily moments with each other even when the farmer is not directly involved.[/*]
[*]NPC relationships can develop warmth, tension, curiosity, conflict, or rare/unlikely moments.[/*]
[*]The Hub includes a village social feed so you can inspect social moments and relationship links.[/*]
[*]Some social moments can become future gossip or story arc candidates.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Letters and Gifts[/b]
[list]
[*]NPCs can send custom letters through the mailbox.[/*]
[*]Letters can react to relationship milestones, recent memories, social context, absence, or emotional moments.[/*]
[*]Letters may include safe, configurable gifts with price limits and item blacklists.[/*]
[*]The Hub keeps an archive of received letters.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Emergent Story Arcs[/b]
[list]
[*]AliveNpcs can detect patterns in conversations, gossip, favors, relationships, and social moments.[/*]
[*]Story arcs can have objectives, player choices, consequences, resolution, and post-resolution dialogue.[/*]
[*]Resolved arcs become persistent lore that can affect future dialogue.[/*]
[*]Arc conclusions can play as Heart Event-style scenes, now using real game maps and vanilla-style event presentation.[/*]
[*]The mod currently includes 19 local stage templates for arc conclusions.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Dynamic Scene Events[/b]
[list]
[*]AliveNpcs includes 157 JSON-authored scene events.[/*]
[*]These can add small social, funny, cozy, tense, affectionate, or everyday moments around the valley.[/*]
[*]Scenes use Stardew Valley's event system and localized i18n text.[/*]
[*]External Experimental Content packs can add their own scene directories.[/*]
[/list]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🎬 Dialogue Actions and Interactive Moments[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Bonus Actions Dropdown[/b]
[list]
[*]Special actions appear only when the NPC, location, relationship, and current flow allow them.[/*]
[*]Actions are hidden when they do not make sense, such as during incompatible multi-turn flows, events, cooldowns, child-coded restrictions, or missing relationship gates.[/*]
[*]EC packs can add their own buttons when their mode is active.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Hang Out / Sair juntos[/b]
[list]
[*]Default unlock: 3 hearts.[/*]
[*]Invite an NPC to spend time together through dialogue.[/*]
[*]This is social by default, not automatically romantic.[/*]
[*]The NPC can accept, refuse, set a boundary, or suggest limits based on personality and context.[/*]
[*]Accepted invitations can create a pending scene at a supported destination.[/*]
[*]There are 66 local hang-out templates across tones such as friendship, cozy, walk, slice of life, light date, and awkward.[/*]
[*]Romantic/light-date scenes are restricted to appropriate adult romantic contexts.[/*]
[*]Accepted and rejected invitations have configurable cooldowns.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Dialogue-Based Dating and Marriage Proposals[/b]
[list]
[*]Ask eligible NPCs to date or marry you through free-text dialogue.[/*]
[*]The vanilla Bouquet and Mermaid's Pendant still work.[/*]
[*]The NPC evaluates the proposal using relationship state, memories, boundaries, context, and your exact message.[/*]
[*]Rejections and firm boundaries have cooldowns.[/*]
[*]Marriage proposals can keep the vanilla house-upgrade requirement.[/*]
[*]Narrative availability can matter when the save has created resolved lore around relationships.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Dialogue Item Requests[/b]
[list]
[*]NPCs can ask for small item favors in eligible first-dialogue moments.[/*]
[*]The request becomes a real Stardew Valley quest in the normal quest log.[/*]
[*]The default chance is 5%, configurable from 0% to 100%.[/*]
[*]The NPC remembers the active favor and should not keep asking for another one while it is pending.[/*]
[*]Completed favors can trigger short local scene moments.[/*]
[*]The mod includes 10 local item-request scene templates.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Festivals[/b]
[list]
[*]Supported festivals can use festival-specific prompts instead of normal daily prompts.[/*]
[*]Festival conversations use a separate context so talking at a festival does not simply behave like a normal day interaction.[/*]
[*]The vanilla festival line is used as context, then AliveNpcs can generate a more personal response.[/*]
[*]Current festival packs include Egg Festival dialogue and Flower Dance dialogue.[/*]
[*]Flower Dance includes an [b]Ask to dance[/b] action for eligible NPCs, with accept/decline handling and session-state hiding after a successful partner choice.[/*]
[/list]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🖥️ Hub, Menus, and Diagnostics[/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][font=Courier New]F7[/font] - Character Sheet.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]F8[/font] - Gossip Diary.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]F9[/font] - AliveNpcs Hub.[/*]
[/list]
The AliveNpcs Hub includes:

[list]
[*]Diary[/*]
[*]Story Arcs[/*]
[*]Letters[/*]
[*]Gossip[/*]
[*]Village Social Feed[/*]
[*]Character Sheet[/*]
[*]AI Status[/*]
[*]NPC Compatibility[/*]
[*]Outings / pending hang-out scenes[/*]
[*]Quick Settings[/*]
[/list]
The AI Status tab helps you inspect provider setup, fallback state, recent failures, and connection behavior. Debug token/request counts are hidden by default and can be enabled in settings.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]AI Providers[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Google Gemini[/b]
[list]
[*]Gemini is the default provider.[/*]
[*]You can configure up to 20 Gemini API key slots.[/*]
[*]AliveNpcs can rotate between keys when a key reaches quota or becomes temporarily unavailable.[/*]
[*]The mod has player-facing messages for missing keys, invalid keys, quota fallback, server errors, and high-demand Gemini responses.[/*]
[/list]
[b]OpenAI-Compatible / Local LLM Provider[/b]
[list]
[*]AliveNpcs can use an OpenAI-compatible endpoint instead of Gemini.[/*]
[*]This can be a hosted compatible API or a local model server.[/*]
[*]Configure base URL, model name, optional API key, timeout, and system-prompt behavior in GMCM or config.json.[/*]
[*]Local models require your own hardware and quality depends heavily on the model you run.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Performance Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]AI generation usually takes a few seconds depending on provider, model, internet connection, and prompt size.[/*]
[*]Background systems such as gossip, letters, social moments, weekly news, and story analysis may run after important game moments or day transitions.[/*]
[*]The default settings are tuned for a balanced experience. Play a few in-game days before changing advanced options.[/*]
[/list]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/center]

[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b] are required.[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is optional but strongly recommended.[/*]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] support can be enabled in settings. AliveNpcs includes SVE-aware prompt context and compatibility checks.[/*]
[*][b]Other custom NPC mods[/b] can be enabled experimentally. The mod can inspect NPC source hints and show compatibility details in the Hub.[/*]
[*][b]Experimental Content packs[/b] can add modes, prompts, actions, scenes, and hooks through the AliveNpcs EC platform.[/*]
[*]If an NPC is skipped, the NPC Compatibility tab can help explain why.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]📦 Installation[/b][/size][/center]

[spoiler]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]At least one AI provider:[/*]
[*]Google Gemini API key, or[/*]
[*]OpenAI-compatible/local LLM endpoint[/*]
[*]Optional but recommended: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/*]
[/list]
[b]Steps[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download AliveNpcs.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod into your [font=Courier New]Mods/[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game once.[/*]
[*]Open the mod settings with Generic Mod Config Menu, or edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font].[/*]
[*]Choose your AI provider.[/*]
[*]For Gemini: paste one or more API keys into the Gemini settings page.[/*]
[*]For OpenAI-compatible/local: configure base URL, model name, and optional API key.[/*]
[*]Start or load a save.[/*]
[*]Fill out the Character Sheet when prompted, or press [font=Courier New]F7[/font] later.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Tip for Gemini users[/b]
[list]
[*]The mod supports up to 20 Gemini API key slots.[/*]
[*]Increase the key slot count in GMCM, paste your keys, and AliveNpcs can rotate between configured keys.[/*]
[*]Provider quotas and availability are controlled by Google, not by the mod.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]Safety and Tone Controls[/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*]Most features can be turned on or off individually.[/*]
[*]Adult relationship drama is off by default.[/*]
[*]NPC-to-NPC romance is off by default.[/*]
[*]Orientation discovery is off by default.[/*]
[*]Infidelity arcs are off by default.[/*]
[*]Canon marriage protection is on by default.[/*]
[*]Children and child-coded NPCs are blocked from romantic/adult action paths.[/*]
[*]Drama intensity can be kept cozy, balanced, or raised to telenovela mode.[/*]
[*]Base-game dialogue fallback can be enabled for safer behavior when the AI provider fails.[/*]
[/list]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]Good To Know[/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*]This is an AI mod. Output quality depends on the provider/model you choose.[/*]
[*]Local LLM support does not include a model; you must run or configure one yourself.[/*]
[*]Some systems are experimental and are designed to be configurable.[/*]
[*]If you report a bug, include your SMAPI log, game language, AI provider/model, NPC name, in-game date/time, and what you typed.[/*]
[*]The mod is designed for roleplay and emergent storytelling, so the best results come from writing natural messages instead of trying to force commands.[/*]
[/list]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]
